html:
G'oya

Tarif keyingi almashtirishgacha amal qiladi, demak har bir yozuvga shu foydalanuvchining keyingi yozuvi kerak. Bu LEAD ning ishi: OVER dagi tartib bo'yicha keyingi qatorning qiymatini beradi. Foydalanuvchilar aralashib ketmasligi uchun PARTITION BY user_id.

Yechim

SELECT user_id, plan, day AS start_day,
       LEAD(day) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY day) AS end_day
FROM plan_changes

Namunada 1-foydalanuvchi 1-kuni Free, 15-kuni Pro, 40-kuni Team tarifiga o'tgan. Free 15 gacha, Pro 40 gacha amal qilgan, Team esa hali amalda: undan keyin qator yo'q va LEAD NULL qaytaradi. Shart ham aynan NULL ni so'rayapti.

Tuzoqlar

PARTITION BY siz keyingi qator boshqa foydalanuvchiniki bo'lib qoladi. Namunada 1-foydalanuvchining Free tarifi 15-kungacha emas, 2-foydalanuvchining 3-kundagi yozuvigacha "amal qilgan" bo'lib chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT user_id, plan, day AS start_day,
       LEAD(day) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS end_day
FROM plan_changes

LEAD(day, 1, 0) oxirgi tarifga 0 yozadi. 0 kunda tugagan tarif degan ma'no chiqadi, aslida esa u hali tugamagan.

LEAD(day) - 1 ham kerak emas. Shartda end_day keyingi almashtirish kuni deb aniq aytilgan.
